hypotheses.justification: The instance follows from `hCopen : IsOpen C`. `Point n` is an `abbrev` for `Fin n -> Real` (Foundation.lean:28), so it carries the product topology. Mathlib has the instance `LocallyCompactSpace (Fin n → ℝ)`: a finite product of locally compact spaces is locally compact. Mathlib's `IsOpen.locallyCompactSpace` (Topology/Compactness/LocallyCompact.lean:224) takes `[LocallyCompactSpace X]` and `(hs : IsOpen s)` and returns `LocallyCompactSpace s`. So `hCopen.locallyCompactSpace` gives `LocallyCompactSpace C`. The rest of the statement does not need the instance to elaborate. These definitions take only sets, functions and operators and have no instance argument: `DirichletBarrierPair`, `DirichletComparisonPrinciple`, `BoundaryLowerTraceOn`, `BoundaryUpperTraceOn`, `PerronLowerEnvelopeBentQuadraticSourceOuterClosedBallGeometricSemijetLscSelectionPatch`, `DirichletSolutionOn`, `upperEnvelope` and `perronEnvelope`. Fix to the proof: start with `haveI : LocallyCompactSpace C := hCopen.locallyCompactSpace`, then make the same call to `of_perronFamily_top_and_bentSourceOuterClosedBallGeometricSemijetLscSelectionPatch` with the same arguments. The theorem therefore stays true and provable without the binder.
